dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: Some research topic on folk beliefs... What's the point of that?

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: It's about the belief of Children of the Forest near Vimara Village...

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: According to my inference, it must be because wild vegetables grow luxuriantly here, and they were anthropomorphized... That's how the Children of the Forest came to be.

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: *sigh* Jokes aside, this topic is far less interesting than studying the human body...

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: Nah, it isn't as scary as you're thinking. It's just some extended topics on fighting techniques.

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: How must the body be controlled to release unimaginable strength? Aren't you all curious about that?

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: But while I've suggested it a few times, not a single mentor has been willing to approve it...

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: So, I had no choice but to comply with my assignment and research this topic related to folk beliefs...

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: I think this can't be allowed to go on. Someone must let the Akademiya know that there are many other research directions that are worth our attention.

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: Thanks for your encouragement. Knowing that there are still people who share my thoughts raises my confidence again.

dialogues.speaker: Nabati
dialogues.text: A researcher should have the courage and determination to speak their mind!
